3.1 मासिक किस्त (EMI) प्रत्येक माह की 5 तारीख को देय होगी।

3.2 भुगतान ECS, NACH, या ऑनलाइन बैंकिंग के माध्यम से किया जा सकता है।

5.1 ऋणकर्ता को ₹5,00,000 से अधिक ऋण पर जीवन बीमा कवर लेना अनिवार्य है।

5.2 बीमा प्रीमियम ऋणकर्ता द्वारा वहन किया जाएगा।

## Article 1: Loan Amount and Interest Rate

|------------|------------------|

| Cheque Bounce Charge | ₹500 per incident |
| Loan Cancellation Fee | ₹3,000 + GST |

भारत इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स लिमिटेड ने वित्तीय वर्ष 2023-24 की तीसरी तिमाही में उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन दर्ज किया है। कंपनी का कुल राजस्व ₹4,850 करोड़ रहा, जो पिछली तिमाही की तुलना में 12.3% की वृद्धि दर्शाता है। रक्षा अनुबंधों में वृद्धि और निर्यात बाजार में मजबूत उपस्थिति के कारण यह सकारात्मक परिणाम प्राप्त हुआ।

### तिमाही तुलनात्मक विवरण

| वित्तीय मापदंड | Q1 2023-24 (अप्रैल-जून) | Q2 2023-24 (जुलाई-सितंबर) | Q3 2023-24 (अक्टूबर-दिसंबर) |

| **शुद्ध लाभ (₹ करोड़)** | 512 | 568 | 654 |
| **EBITDA मार्जिन (%)** | 17.5% | 17.5% | 18.0% |

### मुख्य उपलब्धियां

रक्षा इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स विभाग ने ₹3,250 करोड़ का राजस्व उत्पन्न किया, जबकि नागरिक उत्पाद खंड ने ₹1,600 करोड़ का योगदान दिया। निर्यात राजस्व ₹485 करोड़ रहा, जो कुल राजस्व का 10% है।

## भविष्य की योजनाएं

कंपनी अगली तिमाही में नए उत्पाद लॉन्च करने और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बाजारों में विस्तार करने की योजना बना रही है।

## PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia

**Jakarta, 15 Oktober 2023** - PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia (MSTI) mengumumkan hasil kinerja keuangan untuk kuartal ketiga tahun 2023 yang menunjukkan pertumbuhan signifikan di semua lini bisnis.

### Ringkasan Kinerja Keuangan

Perusahaan mencatat pendapatan konsolidasi sebesar Rp 2,45 triliun pada Q3 2023, meningkat 18,5% dibandingkan kuartal sebelumnya. Pertumbuhan ini didorong oleh ekspansi layanan cloud computing dan solusi digital untuk sektor perbankan dan ritel.

Laba operasional mencapai Rp 687 miliar, naik 22,3% dari Q2 2023, mencerminkan efisiensi operasional yang lebih baik dan margin keuntungan yang meningkat. Laba bersih perusahaan tercatat Rp 512 miliar, tumbuh 19,8% secara quarter-on-quarter.

### Tabel Kinerja Keuangan Tiga Kuartal Terakhir

| Indikator | Q1 2023 | Q2 2023 | Q3 2023 |
|-----------|---------|---------|---------|
| **Pendapatan (Rp Miliar)** | 1.856 | 2.067 | 2.450 |
| **Laba Operasional (Rp Miliar)** | 498 | 562 | 687 |
| **Laba Bersih (Rp Miliar)** | 371 | 427 | 512 |
| **Margin Laba Operasional (%)** | 26,8 | 27,2 | 28,0 |
| **Margin Laba Bersih (%)** | 20,0 | 20,7 | 20,9 |

### Analisis Segmen Bisnis

Divisi Cloud & Infrastructure Services menyumbang 58% dari total pendapatan dengan nilai Rp 1,42 triliun. Sementara itu, segmen Digital Solutions mencatatkan pertumbuhan tertinggi sebesar 35% YoY dengan pendapatan Rp 735 miliar.

Direktur Utama MSTI, Bapak Andrian Wijaya, menyatakan: "Kinerja Q3 2023 mencerminkan komitmen kami dalam memberikan solusi teknologi terdepan. Kami optimis dapat mempertahankan momentum pertumbuhan ini hingga akhir tahun dengan target pendapatan tahunan mencapai Rp 9,2 triliun."

### Proyeksi dan Outlook

Manajemen memproyeksikan pertumbuhan pendapatan sebesar 15-20% untuk Q4 2023, didukung oleh pipeline proyek senilai Rp 3,1 triliun dan ekspansi ke 12 kota baru di Indonesia.

## PT Mitra Sejahtera Teknologi Indonesia

The Company recorded consolidated revenue of Rp 2.45 trillion in Q3 2023, an increase of 18.5% compared to the previous quarter. This growth was driven by the expansion of cloud computing services and digital solutions for the banking and retail sectors.

## PASAL 1: KETENTUAN UMUM

1.1 Kartu Kredit Platinum PT Bank Nusantara Sejahtera ("Bank") diterbitkan untuk nasabah yang memenuhi persyaratan dengan limit kredit minimum Rp 15.000.000 (lima belas juta rupiah).

1.2 Pemegang kartu wajib membayar iuran tahunan sebesar Rp 750.000 (tujuh ratus lima puluh ribu rupiah) untuk kartu utama dan Rp 375.000 (tiga ratus tujuh puluh lima ribu rupiah) untuk kartu tambahan.

## PASAL 2: BIAYA DAN BUNGA

2.1 Suku bunga yang dikenakan adalah 2,25% per bulan atau 27% per tahun untuk transaksi ritel dan 2,95% per bulan atau 35,4% per tahun untuk transaksi tarik tunai.

2.2 Biaya keterlambatan pembayaran:

| Jumlah Tagihan | Biaya Keterlambatan |
|---|---|
| Rp 0 - Rp 5.000.000 | Rp 150.000 |
| Rp 5.000.001 - Rp 20.000.000 | Rp 250.000 |
| > Rp 20.000.000 | Rp 400.000 |

2.3 Biaya tarik tunai sebesar 4% dari jumlah penarikan dengan minimum Rp 75.000.

2.4 Biaya transaksi luar negeri dikenakan sebesar 3,5% dari nilai transaksi dalam mata uang asing.

## PASAL 3: PEMBAYARAN

3.1 Pembayaran minimum adalah 10% dari total tagihan atau Rp 100.000, mana yang lebih besar.

3.2 Tanggal jatuh tempo pembayaran adalah 20 hari setelah tanggal cetak tagihan.

3.3 Pembayaran dapat dilakukan melalui transfer bank, ATM, mobile banking, atau kantor cabang Bank.

## PASAL 4: PROGRAM REWARD

4.1 Setiap transaksi Rp 10.000 akan mendapatkan 1 poin reward.

4.2 Poin reward berlaku selama 24 bulan sejak tanggal transaksi.

4.3 Minimum penukaran poin adalah 5.000 poin.

## PASAL 5: PENUTUPAN KARTU

5.1 Bank berhak menutup kartu tanpa pemberitahuan terlebih dahulu jika terjadi tunggakan lebih dari 90 hari.

5.2 Biaya penutupan kartu atas permintaan nasabah adalah Rp 100.000.

2.1 The interest rate charged is 2.25% per month or 27% per annum for retail transactions and 2.95% per month or 35.4% per annum for cash advance transactions.

|---|---|

| > Rp 20,000,000 | Rp 400,000 |

2.3 Cash advance fee of 4% of the withdrawal amount with a minimum of Rp 75,000.

2.4 Foreign transaction fee charged at 3.5% of the transaction value in foreign currency.

## ARTICLE 3: PAYMENT

3.1 The minimum payment is 10% of the total billing amount or Rp 100,000, whichever is greater.

5.1 The Bank reserves the right to close the card without prior notice if arrears exceed 90 days.

## Eurogrowth Azionario Italia Plus

**Codice ISIN:** IT0005478962  
**Data di lancio:** 15 marzo 2018  
**Società di gestione:** Investimenti Bancari SGR S.p.A.  
**Depositario:** Banca Nazionale del Lavoro S.p.A.  
**Valuta di denominazione:** EUR  
**Patrimonio netto:** €247.350.000 (al 31 dicembre 2024)

### Obiettivo di Investimento

Il fondo Eurogrowth Azionario Italia Plus mira a conseguire una crescita del capitale nel medio-lungo termine attraverso investimenti prevalentemente in azioni di società italiane quotate sul mercato MTA di Borsa Italiana. Il fondo investe almeno il 70% del patrimonio in titoli azionari di emittenti con sede legale in Italia o che svolgono la parte predominante della loro attività economica nel territorio italiano. La restante quota può essere investita in strumenti del mercato monetario, obbligazioni governative e corporate investment grade.

### Struttura delle Commissioni

| Tipo di Commissione | Percentuale/Importo |
|---------------------|---------------------|
| Commissione di sottoscrizione | 2,50% |
| Commissione di gestione annua | 1,85% |
| Commissione di performance | 15% sulla sovraperformance vs FTSE MIB |
| Commissione di rimborso | 0,00% |
| Spese correnti (TER) | 2,12% |

### Rendimenti Storici Annuali

| Anno | Rendimento Netto | Benchmark (FTSE MIB) |
|------|------------------|----------------------|
| 2024 | +12,4% | +11,8% |
| 2023 | +18,7% | +16,2% |
| 2022 | -8,3% | -9,1% |
| 2021 | +22,5% | +21,3% |
| 2020 | -5,6% | -6,4% |

**Investimento minimo iniziale:** €5.000  
**Versamenti successivi minimi:** €500  
**Profilo di rischio SRRI:** 6 su 7

### Avvertenze sui Rischi

Il presente fondo è soggetto a rischio di mercato azionario elevato. Il valore delle quote può subire oscillazioni significative anche nel breve periodo. Non vi è garanzia di restituzione del capitale investito. I rendimenti passati non sono indicativi di quelli futuri. L'investimento in azioni comporta il rischio di perdita parziale o totale del capitale. Il fondo è esposto al rischio di concentrazione geografica sul mercato italiano e al rischio di cambio per eventuali investimenti in valute diverse dall'euro. Si raccomanda un orizzonte temporale di investimento minimo di 5 anni.

**Gruppo Industriale Mediterraneo S.p.A.**

Milano, 15 ottobre 2024

## Sintesi dei Risultati del Terzo Trimestre

Il Consiglio di Amministrazione di Gruppo Industriale Mediterraneo S.p.A. (GIM) ha approvato oggi i risultati consolidati per il terzo trimestre dell'esercizio fiscale 2024, chiuso al 30 settembre 2024.

### Andamento Economico-Finanziario

Il Gruppo ha registrato una performance solida nel terzo trimestre, con ricavi totali pari a €487,3 milioni, in crescita del 12,4% rispetto allo stesso periodo dell'anno precedente. L'EBITDA adjusted si è attestato a €94,6 milioni, con un margine del 19,4%.

La divisione Automotive ha contribuito significativamente ai risultati, generando €312,8 milioni di fatturato, mentre il settore Componenti Industriali ha raggiunto €174,5 milioni. L'utile operativo (EBIT) del trimestre è stato di €68,2 milioni, rappresentando un incremento del 15,7% su base annua.

## Dati Finanziari Consolidati

| Periodo | Ricavi (€ mln) | Utile Operativo (€ mln) | Utile Netto (€ mln) |
|---------|----------------|-------------------------|---------------------|
| Q1 2024 | 445,7 | 61,3 | 42,8 |
| Q2 2024 | 468,9 | 65,7 | 46,2 |
| Q3 2024 | 487,3 | 68,2 | 48,9 |

### Posizione Finanziaria Netta

Al 30 settembre 2024, la posizione finanziaria netta del Gruppo risulta positiva per €156,4 milioni, migliorata rispetto ai €142,7 milioni del trimestre precedente. Il flusso di cassa operativo ha raggiunto €73,5 milioni nel Q3.

### Prospettive

L'Amministratore Delegato, Dott. Marco Bellini, ha dichiarato: "I risultati del terzo trimestre confermano la solidità del nostro modello di business. Prevediamo di chiudere l'anno fiscale 2024 con ricavi superiori a €1,9 miliardi e un margine EBITDA intorno al 19%."

Il Gruppo conferma gli investimenti pianificati di €85 milioni per l'innovazione tecnologica e la sostenibilità ambientale nei prossimi dodici mesi.

## 第1条（商品の名称）

本ファンドの運用は、東京アセットマネジメント株式会社（金融商品取引業者 関東財務局長（金商）第1234号）が行います。

本ファンドに係る手数料は以下の通りとします：

| 手数料種別 | 料率・金額 | 徴収時期 |
|---------|----------|---------|
| 購入時手数料 | 購入金額の3.30%（税込） | 購入時 |
| 信託報酬 | 純資産総額に対して年率1.65%（税込） | 日々計上 |
| 信託財産留保額 | 解約時の基準価額の0.30% | 解約時 |
| 監査報酬 | 年間1,200,000円（税込） | 年次 |

## 第4条（最低投資金額）

1. 初回購入時の最低投資金額は100,000円とします。
2. 追加購入時の最低投資金額は10,000円とします。
3. 積立投資プランの場合、月額5,000円から設定可能とします。

## 第5条（基準価額の計算）

1. 基準価額は、信託財産の純資産総額を受益権総口数で除した金額とし、1万口当たりの価額で表示します。
2. 基準価額の計算は、原則として毎営業日の午後3時における信託財産の資産評価額に基づき行います。

## 第6条（収益分配）

1. 収益分配は年2回、毎年5月15日および11月15日（休業日の場合は翌営業日）に決算を行い、分配金を支払います。
2. 分配金は1万口当たり50円を下限とし、運用状況により変動します。
3. 分配金の再投資を選択した場合、購入時手数料は無料とします。

## 第7条（解約）

1. 受益者は、販売会社の営業日において解約請求が可能です。
2. 解約代金は、解約請求受付日から起算して5営業日目からお支払いします。
3. 大量解約により信託財産の換金が困難な場合、解約請求の受付を中止することがあります。

## 第8条（課税関係）

普通分配金および解約時・償還時の譲渡益は、20.315%（所得税15.315%、住民税5%）の税率が適用されます。

## 第9条（約款の変更）

2024年4月1日より本約款を施行します。

# Investment Trust Agreement

## Article 1 (Name of Product)

This investment trust shall be called "Global Growth Equity Fund 2024" (hereinafter referred to as "the Fund").

## Article 2 (Management Company)

The Fund shall be managed by Tokyo Asset Management Co., Ltd. (Financial Instruments Business Operator, Kanto Local Finance Bureau Director (Kinsho) No. 1234).

## Article 3 (Fee Structure)

Fees related to the Fund shall be as follows:

| Fee Type | Rate/Amount | Collection Timing |
|---------|----------|---------|
| Purchase Fee | 3.30% of purchase amount (tax included) | At time of purchase |
| Trust Fee | Annual rate of 1.65% of total net assets (tax included) | Accrued daily |
| Trust Property Retention Amount | 0.30% of base price at time of redemption | At time of redemption |
| Audit Fee | 1,200,000 yen per annum (tax included) | Annual |

## Article 4 (Minimum Investment Amount)

1. The minimum investment amount for initial purchase shall be 100,000 yen.
2. The minimum investment amount for additional purchases shall be 10,000 yen.
3. In the case of an installment investment plan, it may be set from 5,000 yen per month.

## Article 5 (Calculation of Base Price)

1. The base price shall be the amount obtained by dividing the total net assets of the trust property by the total number of beneficial interest units, and shall be expressed as the price per 10,000 units.
2. The calculation of the base price shall, in principle, be conducted based on the asset valuation of the trust property at 3:00 p.m. on each business day.

## Article 6 (Income Distribution)

1. Income distribution shall be made twice a year, with settlements on May 15 and November 15 of each year (or the following business day if a holiday), and dividends shall be paid.
2. Dividends shall have a lower limit of 50 yen per 10,000 units and shall vary depending on management performance.
3. If reinvestment of dividends is selected, the purchase fee shall be waived.

## Article 7 (Redemption)

1. Beneficiaries may request redemption on business days of the sales company.
2. Redemption proceeds shall be paid from the fifth business day counting from the redemption request acceptance date.
3. In the event that liquidation of trust property becomes difficult due to large-scale redemptions, acceptance of redemption requests may be suspended.

## Article 8 (Taxation)

Ordinary dividends and capital gains at the time of redemption/maturity shall be subject to a tax rate of 20.315% (income tax 15.315%, resident tax 5%).

## Article 9 (Amendment of Agreement)

This agreement shall come into effect from April 1, 2024.

# Third Quarter Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2024

**Technology Solutions Corporation**  
Report Date: November 15, 2024

## Business Performance Overview

In the third quarter of 2024 (July–September), the Company achieved solid growth compared to the same period of the previous year. Due to the expansion of our cloud services business and strong performance in our AI solutions division, net sales increased 18.5% year-on-year to ¥42,800 million.

Operating income was ¥8,560 million (up 22.3% year-on-year), and net income was ¥5,940 million (up 19.8% year-on-year), representing our highest quarterly results to date.

## Quarterly Performance Trends

| Item | 2024 Q1 | 2024 Q2 | 2024 Q3 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|
| Net Sales (millions of yen) | 38,500 | 40,200 | 42,800 |
| Operating Income (millions of yen) | 7,200 | 7,850 | 8,560 |
| Net Income (millions of yen) | 4,980 | 5,420 | 5,940 |
| Operating Margin (%) | 18.7 | 19.5 | 20.0 |

## Results by Business Segment

**Cloud Services Division:** Net sales of ¥25,680 million (up 24.5% year-on-year)  
Demand for enterprise cloud infrastructure services continued to expand, with new contracts increasing 15% compared to the previous quarter.

**AI Solutions Division:** Net sales of ¥12,340 million (up 28.7% year-on-year)  
Sales of generative AI-related products were strong, with solutions for the financial services industry showing particularly significant growth.

**Systems Integration Division:** Net sales of ¥4,780 million (down 2.1% year-on-year)  
Results declined slightly as the completion timing of certain large-scale projects was pushed back to the fourth quarter.

## Full-Year Performance Forecast

We are revising our full-year performance forecast for fiscal year 2024 upward. We expect net sales of ¥165,000 million (previous forecast: ¥160,000 million), operating income of ¥32,500 million (previous forecast: ¥30,000 million), and net income of ¥22,500 million (previous forecast: ¥20,800 million).

In the fourth quarter as well, we anticipate maintaining solid growth due to the continued expansion of digital transformation demand.

### Основные финансовые показатели

ООО "Северная Промышленная Группа" представляет консолидированные финансовые результаты за третий квартал 2024 финансового года. Компания продолжает демонстрировать устойчивый рост основных финансовых показателей несмотря на сложную макроэкономическую ситуацию.

|-----------|---------|---------|---------|

| Операционная прибыль (млн руб.) | 892,4 | 1 045,6 | 1 234,7 |
| Чистая прибыль (млн руб.) | 634,8 | 756,3 | 891,5 |

### Анализ результатов

Выручка компании в третьем квартале 2024 года составила 5 891,2 млн рублей, что на 12,5% превышает показатель предыдущего квартала и на 23,7% выше результата аналогичного периода прошлого года. Рост выручки обусловлен увеличением объемов производства на Новосибирском заводе и успешным запуском нового производственного комплекса в Екатеринбурге.

Операционная прибыль достигла 1 234,7 млн рублей с рентабельностью 21,0%. Чистая прибыль за отчетный период составила 891,5 млн рублей, что на 17,9% выше показателя второго квартала. Рентабельность по чистой прибыли составила 15,1%.

### Ключевые события квартала

В августе 2024 года компания завершила модернизацию производственных мощностей на сумму 450 млн рублей. Совет директоров одобрил выплату промежуточных дивидендов в размере 12,50 рублей на акцию, общая сумма выплат составит 287,5 млн рублей.

**Прогноз на IV квартал 2024 года:** Руководство компании ожидает сохранения положительной динамики с прогнозируемой выручкой в диапазоне 6 100-6 300 млн рублей.

November 15, 2024

## Operating Results Summary

Siam Technology Public Company Limited reports its operating results for Q3 2024 (July - September 2024). # TÜRKİYE FİNANS BANKASI A.Ş. CREDIT CARD MEMBERSHIP AGREEMENT AND GENERAL TERMS

## Article 1: Parties and Definitions

This agreement has been executed between Türkiye Finans Bankası A.Ş. (the Bank) and the cardholder on January 15, 2024. The Platinum credit card issued under the agreement may be used for domestic and international purchases.

## Article 2: Fees and Commissions

The fee schedule applicable to the card is specified below:

| Fee Type | Amount (TL) | Application Period |
|----------|-------------|-------------------|
| Annual Card Membership Fee | 850.00 | Annual |
| Supplementary Card Fee | 425.00 | Annual |
| Cash Advance Commission | 3.95% | Per Transaction |
| Foreign Transaction Commission | 2.75% | Per Transaction |
| Wire Transfer/EFT Commission | 45.50 | Per Transaction |
| Statement Delivery Fee (Paper) | 12.00 | Monthly |

## Article 3: Interest Rates

The monthly interest rate applicable to card accounts is 4.25%, corresponding to an annual effective interest rate of 64.38%. Late payment interest shall be applied at 4.85% monthly.

## Article 4: Payment Terms

The cardholder is obligated to pay at least the minimum payment amount (20% of the total debt or TL 500, whichever is higher) by the payment due date from the statement date. The statement date is the 15th of each month, and the payment due date is the 5th of the month.

## Article 5: Installments

Transactions of TL 1,500 and above may be made with 3, 6, 9, or 12 installment options. A monthly installment interest rate of 1.85% applies to installment transactions.

## Article 6: Spending Limit

The initial credit limit has been set at TL 75,000. The cash advance limit is TL 30,000, which is 40% of the total limit.

## Article 7: Right of Withdrawal

The customer may exercise the right of withdrawal within 14 days from the contract date without providing any justification.

## Finansal Performans Özeti

Şirketimiz, 2024 yılının üçüncü çeyreğinde güçlü büyüme ivmesini sürdürerek toplam 2,8 milyar TL konsolide net satış hasılatı elde etmiştir. Bu rakam, geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre %34,5'lik bir artışı temsil etmektedir.

| Dönem | Net Satışlar (milyon TL) | Faaliyet Karı (milyon TL) | Net Dönem Karı (milyon TL) |
|-------|-------------------------|---------------------------|---------------------------|
| Ç1 2024 | 2.450 | 385 | 298 |
| Ç2 2024 | 2.620 | 412 | 325 |
| Ç3 2024 | 2.800 | 448 | 356 |

Üçüncü çeyrekte faaliyet karımız 448 milyon TL'ye ulaşarak %16,0 faaliyet kar marjı gerçekleşmiştir. Net dönem karımız ise 356 milyon TL olarak kaydedilmiş olup, net kar marjımız %12,7 seviyesindedir.

Nakit ve nakit benzeri varlıklarımız 1,6 milyar TL'dir. Net finansal borç/FAVÖK oranımız 0,85 seviyesinde olup, sağlıklı bilanço yapımızı korumaktayız.

## Gelecek Dönem Beklentileri

Yönetim kurulumuz, 2024 yılı sonunda toplam net satışların 11,2 milyar TL'ye ulaşacağını ve FAVÖK marjının %18-19 bandında gerçekleşeceğini öngörmektedir.

**Istanbul, October 15, 2024** - TürkTech Holding A.Ş. (BIST: TTECH) announced its consolidated financial results for the third quarter of 2024.

Our company achieved total consolidated net sales revenue of TL 2.8 billion in the third quarter of 2024, maintaining strong growth momentum. This figure represents an increase of 34.5% compared to the same period last year.

| Period | Net Sales (million TL) | Operating Profit (million TL) | Net Profit for the Period (million TL) |
|-------|-------------------------|---------------------------|---------------------------|

In the third quarter, our operating profit reached TL 448 million, achieving an operating profit margin of 16.0%. Our net profit for the period was recorded at TL 356 million, with our net profit margin at 12.7%.

Our R&D investments increased to TL 145 million this quarter, representing 5.2% of our total revenue. Within the scope of our digital transformation projects, we continue to increase our investments in artificial intelligence and cloud computing.

As of September 30, 2024, our total assets reached TL 8.5 billion. Our equity stands at TL 4.2 billion and our return on equity (ROE) was 28.4%.

Our cash and cash equivalents amount to TL 1.6 billion. Our net financial debt/EBITDA ratio is at 0.85, maintaining our healthy balance sheet structure.

## Future Period Outlook

Our board of directors forecasts that total net sales will reach TL 11.2 billion by year-end 2024 and that the EBITDA margin will be in the 18-19% range.

## CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN CÔNG NGHỆ VIETTECH

**Ngày công bố:** 15 tháng 10 năm 2024

### TỔNG QUAN KẾT QUẢ KINH DOANH

Công ty Cổ phần Công nghệ VietTech (mã chứng khoán: VTC) trân trọng công bố kết quả kinh doanh quý 3 năm 2024. Trong quý vừa qua, công ty đã đạt được những thành tựu đáng kể với tổng doanh thu đạt 456,8 tỷ đồng, tăng trưởng 18,5% so với cùng kỳ năm trước.

### CHỈ SỐ TÀI CHÍNH CHỦ YẾU

| Chỉ tiêu | Quý 1/2024 | Quý 2/2024 | Quý 3/2024 |
|----------|------------|------------|------------|
| **Doanh thu thuần** | 398,2 tỷ VNĐ | 425,6 tỷ VNĐ | 456,8 tỷ VNĐ |
| **Lợi nhuận từ hoạt động kinh doanh** | 89,5 tỷ VNĐ | 95,8 tỷ VNĐ | 108,3 tỷ VNĐ |
| **Lợi nhuận sau thuế** | 67,2 tỷ VNĐ | 72,4 tỷ VNĐ | 82,6 tỷ VNĐ |

### PHÂN TÍCH CHI TIẾT

**Doanh thu:** Doanh thu thuần quý 3 đạt 456,8 tỷ đồng, tăng 7,3% so với quý 2/2024. Sự tăng trưởng này chủ yếu đến từ mảng giải pháp chuyển đổi số cho doanh nghiệp, đóng góp 245,3 tỷ đồng (chiếm 53,7% tổng doanh thu).

**Lợi nhuận hoạt động kinh doanh:** Đạt 108,3 tỷ đồng trong quý 3, tăng 13,0% so với quý trước. Biên lợi nhuận hoạt động kinh doanh cải thiện lên 23,7%, cao hơn 1,2 điểm phần trăm so với quý 2/2024 nhờ vào việc tối ưu hóa chi phí vận hành và nâng cao hiệu suất sản xuất.

**Lợi nhuận sau thuế:** Lợi nhuận sau thuế đạt 82,6 tỷ đồng, tăng 14,1% so với quý trước, tương đương biên lợi nhuận ròng 18,1%. Thu nhập trên mỗi cổ phiếu (EPS) đạt 3.850 đồng/cổ phiếu.

### TRIỂN VỌNG QUÝ 4/2024

Ban lãnh đạo VietTech kỳ vọng duy trì đà tăng trưởng trong quý 4 với mục tiêu doanh thu đạt 480-500 tỷ đồng, nhờ vào các hợp đồng lớn đã ký kết với các tập đoàn viễn thông và ngân hàng hàng đầu Việt Nam.

**Release date:** October 15, 2024

### BUSINESS RESULTS OVERVIEW

VietTech Technology Joint Stock Company (stock code: VTC) is pleased to announce its business results for Q3 2024. During the past quarter, the company achieved significant accomplishments with total revenue reaching VND 456.8 billion, an increase of 18.5% compared to the same period last year.

**Operating profit:** Reached VND 108.3 billion in Q3, up 13.0% compared to the previous quarter. Operating profit margin improved to 23.7%, 1.2 percentage points higher than Q2/2024 thanks to operating cost optimization and enhanced production efficiency.

**Profit after tax:** Profit after tax reached VND 82.6 billion, up 14.1% compared to the previous quarter, equivalent to a net profit margin of 18.1%. Earnings per share (EPS) reached VND 3,850/share.

### Q4/2024 OUTLOOK

VietTech's management expects to maintain growth momentum in Q4 with a revenue target of VND 480-500 billion, thanks to major contracts signed with leading telecommunications groups and banks in Vietnam.

Huatai Technology Co., Ltd. (Stock Code: SH688123) achieved steady growth in the third quarter of 2024. The Company's operating revenue for the quarter reached RMB 4.58 billion, representing a year-on-year increase of 18.3% and a quarter-on-quarter increase of 6.7%. **Semiconductor Business:** Third-quarter semiconductor revenue reached RMB 2.83 billion, accounting for 61.8% of total revenue. Shipments of the company’s internally developed HT-9000 series AI chips surpassed 1.5 million units, up 42% from the previous quarter.

R&D expenses totaled RMB 680 million for the quarter, representing 14.8% of revenue. The company achieved significant breakthroughs in advanced process technologies and next-generation computing architectures and has filed 87 patent applications.

The company expects fourth-quarter 2024 revenue to reach RMB 4.8–5.2 billion, with full-year revenue likely to exceed RMB 18 billion. Management remains optimistic about future market demand.

| 认购费 | 1.2% | 一次性扣除 | 认购金额≥100万元可减免至0.8% |

| 赎回费 | 0.5%-2.0% | 赎回时扣除 | 持有期<30天收取2.0% |
| 业绩报酬 | 超额收益的20% | 年度结算 | 基准收益率为4.5% |

**第四条** 最低认购金额为人民币50,000元，追加认购最低金额为10,000元。单笔赎回最低金额为5,000元，账户最低保留余额为10,000元。

**第九条** 本协议有效期为3年，自2024年4月1日至2027年3月31日。到期后可续约。

**第十条** 争议解决：双方协商不成的，提交上海国际经济贸易仲裁委员会仲裁。

## Chapter I General Provisions

**Article 1** This Agreement is entered into by and between Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (hereinafter referred to as "Party A") and the Client (hereinafter referred to as "Party B"), and shall apply to the "Wealth Value-Added Treasure" wealth management product series.

**Article 2** The product commencement date is April 1, 2024, with an initial subscription period from March 15, 2024 to March 29, 2024.

## Chapter II Fee Provisions

**Article 3** The relevant fee schedule is as follows:

| Fee Type | Fee Standard | Collection Method | Remarks |
|---------|---------|---------|------|
| Subscription Fee | 1.2% | One-time deduction | Reducible to 0.8% for subscription amount ≥ RMB 1,000,000 |
| Management Fee | 0.85%/annum | Quarterly deduction | Calculated based on actual holding days |
| Custodian Fee | 0.15%/annum | Quarterly deduction | Collected by China Construction Bank |
| Redemption Fee | 0.5%-2.0% | Deducted upon redemption | 2.0% charged for holding period < 30 days |
| Performance Compensation | 20% of excess returns | Annual settlement | Benchmark return rate is 4.5% |

**Article 4** The minimum subscription amount is RMB 50,000, with a minimum additional subscription amount of RMB 10,000. The minimum single redemption amount is RMB 5,000, and the minimum account balance to be retained is RMB 10,000.

**Article 5** Early redemption fee tiers:
- Holding period less than 30 days: 2.0% of principal
- Holding period 30-90 days: 1.5% of principal
- Holding period 91-180 days: 1.0% of principal
- Holding period 181-365 days: 0.5% of principal
- Holding period exceeding 365 days: redemption fee waived

## Chapter III Income Distribution

**Article 6** The expected annualized return rate ranges from 4.8%-6.5%, with actual returns fluctuating based on investment portfolio performance. Income distribution adopts daily interest accrual and quarterly interest payment, with the last business day of each quarter as the income settlement date.

**Article 7** If the product's annualized return rate exceeds the benchmark return rate of 4.5%, 20% of the excess portion shall belong to Party A as performance compensation, with the remaining 80% belonging to Party B.

**Article 8** A risk reserve fund shall be set aside at 10% of management fee income to cover potential investment losses.

## Chapter IV Other Provisions

**Article 9** This Agreement is valid for 3 years, from April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2027. It may be renewed upon expiration.

**Article 10** Dispute Resolution: In the event that the parties fail to reach agreement through negotiation, the dispute shall be submitted to the Shanghai International Economic and Trade Arbitration Commission for arbitration.

# 华泰科技股份有限公司2024年第三季度财报摘要

**发布日期：** 2024年10月28日  
**报告期间：** 2024年7月1日至2024年9月30日

## 一、经营业绩概述

华泰科技股份有限公司（股票代码：SH688123）在2024年第三季度实现了稳健增长。本季度公司营业收入达到人民币45.8亿元，同比增长18.3%，环比增长6.7%。得益于公司在人工智能芯片和云计算领域的持续投入，核心业务板块表现强劲。

## 二、主要财务数据

### 近三季度财务表现对比

| 财务指标 | 2024年Q1 | 2024年Q2 | 2024年Q3 |
|---------|----------|----------|----------|
| 营业收入（亿元） | 38.6 | 42.9 | 45.8 |
| 营业利润（亿元） | 6.2 | 7.8 | 9.1 |
| 净利润（亿元） | 5.1 | 6.4 | 7.6 |
| 毛利率 | 42.3% | 44.1% | 45.8% |
| 净利率 | 13.2% | 14.9% | 16.6% |

## 三、业务板块分析

**半导体业务：** 第三季度半导体业务收入达28.3亿元，占总收入的61.8%。公司自主研发的HT-9000系列AI芯片出货量突破150万片，较上季度增长42%。

**云服务业务：** 云服务收入为12.5亿元，同比增长35.2%。企业客户数量增至3,680家，大客户续约率保持在92%以上。

**其他业务：** 包括技术服务和软件授权在内的其他业务收入5.0亿元。

## 四、研发投入

本季度研发费用投入6.8亿元，占营业收入的14.8%。公司在先进制程工艺和下一代计算架构方面取得重要突破，已提交专利申请87项。

## 五、展望

公司预计2024年第四季度营业收入将达到48-52亿元，全年营业收入有望突破180亿元大关。管理层对未来市场需求保持乐观态度。

# Huatai Technology Co., Ltd. Q3 2024 Financial Report Summary

**Release Date:** October 28, 2024  
**Reporting Period:** July 1, 2024 to September 30, 2024

## I. Business Performance Overview

Huatai Technology Co., Ltd. (Stock Code: SH688123) achieved steady growth in the third quarter of 2024. The Company's operating revenue for the quarter reached RMB 4.58 billion, representing a year-on-year increase of 18.3% and a quarter-on-quarter increase of 6.7%. Benefiting from the Company's continued investment in artificial intelligence chips and cloud computing, core business segments demonstrated strong performance.

## II. Key Financial Data

### Financial Performance Comparison for Recent Three Quarters

| Financial Indicator | 2024 Q1 | 2024 Q2 | 2024 Q3 |
|---------|----------|----------|----------|
| Operating Revenue (RMB billion) | 3.86 | 4.29 | 4.58 |
| Operating Profit (RMB billion) | 0.62 | 0.78 | 0.91 |
| Net Profit (RMB billion) | 0.51 | 0.64 | 0.76 |
| Gross Margin | 42.3% | 44.1% | 45.8% |
| Net Margin | 13.2% | 14.9% | 16.6% |

## III. Business Segment Analysis

**Semiconductor Business:** Third quarter semiconductor business revenue reached RMB 2.83 billion, accounting for 61.8% of total revenue. Shipments of the Company's independently developed HT-9000 series AI chips exceeded 1.5 million units, an increase of 42% compared to the previous quarter.

**Cloud Services Business:** Cloud services revenue was RMB 1.25 billion, up 35.2% year-on-year. The number of enterprise customers increased to 3,680, with major customer renewal rate maintained above 92%.

**Other Businesses:** Other businesses including technical services and software licensing generated revenue of RMB 0.5 billion.

## IV. R&D Investment

R&D expenses for the quarter amounted to RMB 0.68 billion, representing 14.8% of operating revenue. The Company achieved significant breakthroughs in advanced process technology and next-generation computing architecture, and has filed 87 patent applications.

## V. Outlook

The Company expects operating revenue for the fourth quarter of 2024 to reach RMB 4.8-5.2 billion, with full-year operating revenue expected to exceed the RMB 18 billion milestone. Management remains optimistic about future market demand.
